rows.grounds: object of visualization continued from previous verses
object of visualization paired with yoni
celestial cow as object of visualization
compound: heti+mudrā+catuṣṭaya; quartet of weapon gestures to be visualized

items.question: What additional sacred symbols and gestures complete the prescribed meditative visualization?
premises: The preceding verses instruct visualization of male, female, and all-light forms.
This verse adds the womb-source and emblem as objects of contemplation.
It further includes the wish-cow and a quartet of weapon gestures.
items.inference: The meditative practice extends beyond bodily forms to encompass specific sacred symbols and ritual gestures.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the four weapon-mudras is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should also visualize the yoni and the linga, the wish-fulfilling cow, and the quartet of weapon-mudras.
